title: Patient Financial Services Schedule: Billing Arrangements for Laboratory Test Orders
content:
The billing arrangements open to a Laboratory Test Orders accession are set per service class: when self-pay payment falls due, whether client billing may be elected, and how long after collection the billing method may be switched.

| Service class | Self-pay paid in full at collection | Client billing allowed | Client billing allowed for Original Medicare Part B patients | Insurance to self-pay switch window (calendar days after collection) | Self-pay to insurance switch window (calendar days after collection) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Routine Clinical Testing | Yes | Yes | No | 10 | 90 |
| Specialty Clinical Testing | Yes | Yes | No | 10 | 90 |
| Esoteric Reference Testing | No (billed by statement after resulting) | Yes | No | 10 | 60 |
| Molecular Infectious Disease Testing | Yes | Yes | No | 10 | 90 |
| Clinical Toxicology Testing | Yes | Yes | No | 10 | 60 |
| Anatomic Pathology & Cytology | No (billed by statement after resulting) | Yes | No | 10 | 60 |
| Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing | No (billed by statement after resulting) | Yes | No | 30 | 30 |

## Column meanings

- **Self-pay paid in full at collection** — "Yes" means a self-pay order of the class must be paid in full at the time of collection; "No" means it is billed by statement after resulting.
- **Client billing allowed** — whether the ordering practice may elect client billing for the class.
- **Client billing for Original Medicare Part B patients** — whether client billing is allowed when the patient's coverage is Original Medicare Part B (federal direct-billing rule). The answer is No for every class.
- **Insurance to self-pay switch window** — the calendar days after the collection date through which an insurance-billed order may be switched to self-pay; the switch also requires that no claim has been submitted.
- **Self-pay to insurance switch window** — the calendar days after the collection date through which a self-pay order may be switched to insurance billing.

## Reading across the classes

- Every class allows 10 days to move from insurance to self-pay, except Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing, which allows 30.
- Moving from self-pay to insurance is open for 90 days in Routine, Specialty and Molecular Infectious Disease Testing, 60 days in Esoteric Reference Testing, Clinical Toxicology Testing and Anatomic Pathology & Cytology, and 30 days in Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing.
